meta.title: North Star v2 fitting base v1 — the binding specification
meta.identityControl: The approval is bound to the sha256 below. A file that satisfies every numeric gate but differs by one byte is NOT this approved fitting base, and needs a new owner approval.
meta.noImageCall: D-131 made no image call. The artwork comes from the single authorised D-129 call; D-129's claim remains SPENT and untouched.

storage.rule: D-127 §2 — an approved fitting base is stored OUTSIDE both repositories, never in the repository and never under assets/.
storage.why: assets/ is inside the Cloudflare deploy allowlist (listDir() recurses; ASSET_DIRS includes assets with .png), and the GitHub repository is public. Tracking the image would publish a drawn child figure in close-fitting clothing on two independent public surfaces. D-131 leaves that rule intact.
storage.reproducibilityNote: D-127 §2 accepted this explicitly. The checker therefore SKIPS when the image is absent (a fresh clone, CI) and verifies fully when it is present. Use --require to turn absence into a failure.

provenance.source: D-129 raw — the output of the single authorised image call
construction: H0: copy North Star v2's RGBA bytes byte-exact wherever the approved head protect mask has alpha > 0 — 124,099 pixels. Everything else stays the D-129 candidate's own: neck, shoulders, upper arms, forearms, hands, torso, shorts, legs, feet.

H1: apply the project's documented orphan-soft cleanup outside the head zone — clear a pixel with 0 < alpha < 128 that has no orthogonal neighbour at alpha >= 128. 20,191 pixels cleared, 0 kept because inside the head zone. No RGB painting, no redrawing, no interpolation, no generative fill.
Rebuilding H0 and H1 from the same inputs gives byte-identical output.

geometry.asymmetryDefinition: mirror mismatch about the centre axis, divided by 2 × ink; North Star v2 measures 2.60 % under the same definition

gates.orphanSoftServedNote: North Star v2 itself measures 10 under the same method.
gates.renderSizeNote: RENDER_SIZES are D-071's four sizes. The counts are recorded as measured; no budget is defined for them and none is invented here.

handException.accepted: H1's own hands are accepted even though they are not pixel-identical with North Star v2.
grounds: the maximum contour delta is 2 px at 1024×1536, which corresponds to at most about 1 px at 512×768
fingertips differ by at most 1 px
pose, anatomy, expression and drawing style are visually compatible
using the pixel-identical v2 arms produced clearly unacceptable joins on both upper arms
H1 has continuous shoulders, arms, wrists and hands with no visible joins
handException.notExtendedTo: North Star v2's original hands remain the authoritative visual identity in runtime. Future garments must still be validated mounted on the actual runtime avatar before any promotion.

armHandProtectMask.statement: The D-128 arm/hand protect mask is NOT applied to the fitting base. Its difference against North Star v2 is measured and recorded above. This is NOT a passed gate — it is the deliberate consequence of D-131's bounded hand exception, and it must never be reported as a pass.

prohibitions.notARuntimeReplacement: This file may NOT be used as a runtime replacement for North Star v2, as a new runtime avatar, as a production render, or to change the live avatar's hands, arms or base — not without a new, separate owner decision.
prohibitions.notPromotionLicence: Approval of this fitting base is not licence to promote any future garment built on it.
prohibitions.noAssetsDirectory: It may not be copied under assets/ or tracked in either repository — D-127 §2, left intact by D-131.
